Team / Caroline —

Prelim findings from infra traces and instance logs:
- Autoscaler triggered three concurrent scale-ups of hosted-gpu-pool-a at ~08:42 due to a burst of sustained traffic.
- New instances took ~2.8–3.5s to become ready (GPU context + model weight load); while healthy instances show 400–700ms.
- We observed serialized KV cache misses on cold replicas during the first several requests; model init holds the main thread, causing long tail.
- No config rollout or deliberate kernel swap at 08:30–08:50. Same model variant as before.

Attachments: I've uploaded the aggregated trace bundle and the per-instance init logs.
[Attachment: trace_20260914.zip (application/zip)]

Short-term mitigations we can apply now (requires customer opt-in):
1) Immediate warmup policy: 2-minute pre-warm of any newly created instance with a low-rate inference traffic (synthetic prefix) — adds a small cost but reduces p99 immediately. We can enable for FinLytics only.
2) Route traffic to warmed pool in us-west-2 (if they accept capacity bump).
3) Reduce batch size for synchronous routes to avoid long queuing during instance init.

Longer-term: our runtime team will prioritize faster lazy-weight map loading and async KV prefetching. We'll also add a metric to track cold-replica tail latency.

I'll coordinate a temporary warmup toggle if Olivia/Marissa approve and FinLytics wants it.

—Dylan
